description: Remove a link between two issues: name both ends (and, when more than one link joins them, the phrase — 'blocks', 'relates to'), or give the 'linkId' get_issue returned. Ambiguity is refused rather than guessed: two issues joined twice and no phrase given comes back with the links listed. Requires permission to edit BOTH issues. The issues themselves are untouched.

from.description: One end, e.g. 'PM-419'. Not needed when 'linkId' is given.

linkId.description: The link's id, as get_issue returns it in 'links'.

to.description: The other end, e.g. 'PM-417'. Not needed when 'linkId' is given.

type.description: Which link, when the two issues are joined by more than one: the phrase as get_issue says it ('blocks', 'is blocked by', 'relates to').

name: unlink_issues
